lore:
The Dawnseekers, devoted followers of Pangu, are a towering and sturdy people. Cut off from the outside world, they continue to use their own ancient language, known as "Dawnspeak." For generations, the Dawnseekers have passed down the art of forging, dedicating themselves to quelling the turbulent storms that fill the skies of the First Lands. Though small and slender compared to her imposing kin, Chicha's spirit burns no less bright. Inheriting the Dawnseekers' boundless resolve, she swore to forge the strongest weapon ever made.

From the moment she could walk, Chicha lived her days surrounded by ore and steel. She studied every craft and mastered every trade, guided by everyone in her tribe—each of them a master in their own art, and all of them her family. From each of her kin, she learned something new—how to read the veins of ore, temper metal, and master the tools of her craft. Alongside Nezha and the Heaven Hound, she formed the mountain range's finest ore-hunting trio.

The largest forge of the Dawnseekers, seated in the Bu Zhou Workshop, is more than a workplace to Chicha—it's the home dearest to her heart. She borrows Master Zhenren's furnace to hone her craft, though her endless needs have left her with a growing ledger of debt. Yet through each forging, she moves closer to the true art of creation—the understanding that five weapons combined can hold the strength of a hundred. No weapon is born divine, and no smith is born a master. After countless trials and failures, Chicha at last forged her new Five Arms, a weapon that can shift and transform at her will. Now hailed among the Dawnseekers as a true master of the forge, Chicha joins her companions from Chang'an on a journey skyward, seeking a way to calm the raging Chaosflow above.

One day, she may walk beyond the mountains to learn the craft of countless new weapons. But no matter where the road takes her, she holds one truth close to her heart: "Us Dawnseekers always find a path upward."

lore:
In the eyes of the Misty Marshes' forest dwellers, stella is a shrewd and mysterious mystic. Little do they know that she was also once prophesied to be alone, unable to form bonds with anyone.

When she was born, a prophecy stated that she was a bringer of misfortune, destined to be alone. Wherever the lonely girl wandered, she would be met with scornful gazes. Over time, her zeal faded into despair, and she closed herself off from everyone else. Things only changed when the jovial Qi saved her and brought her to the Forest Temple, providing her with companionship and giving her a name of her own. Unfortunately, the Wilting left her home in ruins and her companion dead, and Dyadia was forced to move on, carrying the promise they once shared.

Today, she's the most popular mystic in the whole of Misty Marshes. Her ability to observe how the Flow affects people's bonds borders on the divine. Her predictions never miss, and can even serve as catalysts to bring people together. However, unbeknownst to the public, Dyadia does not trust the Flow to provide all the answers. In fact, to a great degree, she relies on her own observations of her subjects' hearts. The Mansion of Fate is almost always busy collecting information, observing their clients' desires and intentions, crafting predictions, and arranging encounters. Dyadia realized early on that relationships are made possible not because of a higher power, but rather due to people's own desires.

In the dead of the night, Dyadia continues to pen down her predictions for tomorrow's seekers of fates.

Unbeknownst to her, her own fortune has been penned down: "The Marsh of Amnesia keeps memories suspended. A broken bond may yet be mended."

name: Jing
title: Broken Mirage
lore:
Born into a family of Enforcers, Jing grew up within a strict system of training. Her parents went missing while out on a mission, leaving Jing and her younger brother to fend for themselves against the enemies lurking in the shadows. Overnight, the entire responsibility for the family's mission fell heavy upon Jing's shoulders. Unable to cope, Jing and her brother fled their homeland and erased all traces of their family.

In the long days that followed, Jing traveled the world in search of a way to awaken her power. While doing so, Jing also had to act as a parent to her younger brother, suppressing her tender side to raise the boy under strict guidance. Immensely talented in the martial arts, Jing maintained outstanding grades at Jixia Academy, remaining at the top of the school's rankings throughout her time there. However, as a result of her childhood trauma, Jing was cold and aloof, preferring not to have any friends.

Under Fuzi's guidance, Jing learned of the Hall of Mirrors, where great power could be gained by passing certain trials. Master Zhuangzi warned her: "Countless students have been lost within. While full of opportunity, the Hall of Mirrors is also full of danger." Having passed trial after trial within the Hall of Mirrors, Jing finally came to the ultimate test. Before her was a sight beyond imagination: a barren world lay before her eyes, and in it stood a tremendous and solitary mirror. The mirror somehow seemed to have no border, and its depth was limitless.

She saw familiar faces in the mirror: her smiling mother, her kind father, and her innocent younger brother. "Hey, Jing! Come here!" Her brother's cheerful voice called out. Jing couldn't help but take a step back, upon which a jolt of pain shot up her leg. Looking down, Jing saw that she'd stepped on something sharp, and fresh blood was flowing from her foot. After entering the Hall of Mirrors, Jing had placed sharp objects all around to prevent her from getting lost in the hall's enchanting visions.

Jing had come to her senses immediately. If she remained here, this blissful dream would last forever. But out there in the darkness, someone was still waiting for her to rescue them. Jing clenched her fist tightly and smashed it into the mirror, sending cracks outward like spiderwebs until the illusion of her mother and father was completely shattered. The massive mirror burst apart, sending thousands of mirror shards—and shards of illusion—flying. The magical shards burrowed deep within her body, carrying with them a new power. They sliced into her soul, leaving her skin covered in scars.

name: Mayene
title: Martial Genius
lore:
Mayene is the most difficult student at the Jixia Martial Arts Academy. She's talented and smart but also full of strange ideas. A free spirit, she's the "special" student Fuzi often has to keep an eye on.

Her mother left Navenia and fell in love at first sight with her father, a hero from Yong, and this transcontinental love gave birth to Mayene. At the age when every child wished their father were a hero, she regarded heroism as nothing but trouble. Being a hero came with expectations, and fulfilling those expectations often meant making sacrifices. Heroes were no longer people but symbols. Idols. Life is full of possibilities, and choosing to be a hero seemed like one of the worst decisions to her.

Her father was fulfilling his heroic duties when her mother passed away, vindicating her understanding of heroes. She was entrusted to Fuzi, the headmaster of Jixia Academy. She had zero aptitudes in sorcery but showed incredible martial arts talent. Mayene defeated the teacher evaluating her entrance exam in the most unorthodox way possible, shocking the entire academy. After being enrolled, she started dozing off during classes, only passing them with minimum effort. She diligently applied her talents to taking time off and avoiding work. The teachers gave up on her, but Fuzi knew that she was a diamond in the rough.

Fuzi didn't give up on her. After getting caned several times, she tried to figure out how to get him back and shake him off for good. During her countless wrangles with Fuzi, she went from not being able to do anything to putting up a good fight, and eventually, she was able to escape him entirely. There was nothing in Jixia that could hold her back!

When she came of age, Fuzi shipped her to Navenia with a mechcraft luggage and threatened to kick her out if she didn't fulfill her mother's final wish. She reluctantly accepted the mission, which she thought was a walk in the park... Until she met a "fool" named Biron, and her destiny changed. When she was thrown out of a window by a steel arm, she knew that fleeing was in her best interest. However, upon seeing Biron in dire straits, she took the "troublesome" path for the first time in her life. Little did she know this would be her first step toward becoming a "foolish" hero.

"Martial arts is never the same, and neither is life."
